_comment: Two routes, one install. Agent events carry the BUCKET route: route-spawn.sh asks /v1/bucket which tier a spawn needs, report-outcome.sh reports what happened. The Read/Bash/SessionStart events carry COMPACTION, which is local: context_session.py makes no API and no model call, shrinking bulky tool output and large file reads before they reach the context window, with an exact archive and SHA-256 so the original is always recoverable. --no-policy is deliberate: the installer's default pins a behaviour policy at session start, and a plugin must not silently compete with Ponytail or whatever the user already runs. Anyone who wants it can run scripts/context_session.py --install-project with --policy-file instead. The Stop event carries the CACHE NUDGE: cache_miss_nudge.py reads only the usage counts of the transcript, and on a prompt-cache miss tells the user what was re-written and why; on an idle-gap miss over a large context it suggests /compact, since no hook can start compaction itself.
